subject: Pilot qualification: stakeholder map, procurement path, and exception ask
messages:
From: Jenna Alvarez <jenna@carepathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot exploration

Hi Ben —

Great call today. Quick recap on our side and a small ask so we can move fast:

Stakeholders we pulled together on the call:
- Trish Norton, CISO (will own security acceptance)
- Mark Liu, Head of Data & Analytics (technical success / evaluation lead)
- Laura Diaz, Sr. Procurement Manager (contracts / terms)
- Samuel Ortiz, Director of Clinical Ops (end-user sponsor)

Decision criteria summarized by Mark:
1) Data isolation and audit logs (SOC-2 level proof)
2) Predictable latency under 200ms for 95th pct for inference on our typical payloads
3) Unit economics at pilot scale (100k tokens / month) and forecast to production

Attachments: I attached our standard security questionnaire and procurement checklist (Carepath-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx).

Next steps we expect: 1) Redwood to send a short SOW for a 6-week pilot, 2) high-level pricing and any exceptions you would need to grant for pilot terms, and 3) a list of required signers on SOW + procurement timeline.

Two asks from procurement side: if you can note whether Redwood is open to a short-term pilot discount and whether an SLA variance (lower than enterprise SLA) can be included for pilot work. Laura asked we get those committed before we route the SOW to procurement.

Thanks — Jenna
Jenna Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Carepath Health
jenna@carepathhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Alvarez <jenna@carepathhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-28T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot exploration

Jenna —

Thanks for the clear recap and list of stakeholders — really helpful. I opened a short SOW draft (SOW-pilot-draft.docx) and attached a high-level proposal (Redwood-Proposal-v1.pdf) with two pricing options: standard pilot (no discount) and a pilot-with-discount option (30% off list for the first 6 weeks).

Regarding the asks you listed:
- Pilot discount: we can support a timeboxed discount for evaluation. Need internal ok for the 30% figure for a 6-week pilot.
- SLA variance for pilot: we can offer a reduced SLA for pilot (99.5% target) but that requires an approval for a contract exception on the standard enterprise SLA.

I'll loop in my internal approvals thread (security + finance) and get back to you within 72 hours with confirmed exception terms.

Proposed next meeting: short sync with Mark & Trish next Tuesday to agree telemetry and success criteria. Are they available 11/2 at 10am PT?

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Carepath pilot — ask for pricing + SLA exception (quick)

Marissa / Rishi —

Quick context: Carepath Health (contact Jenna Alvarez) is asking for a 6-week pilot SOW. Key constraints from the call below: security signoff (Trish, CISO), Mark Liu (technical evaluation), and Laura Diaz (procurement). They want explicit answers on: pilot discount and SLA variance for the pilot term.

Proposal I drafted: 6-week pilot, 100k tokens/month cap, standard streaming/chat endpoints. Options in the attached proposal:
- Option A: no discount, standard pilot SOW terms
- Option B: 30% discount off list for 6 weeks (timeboxed) + 99.5% pilot SLA instead of our usual enterprise 99.9%

Risk & asks:
- Revenue impact: ~30% reduction for the pilot period; low ARR risk, but helpful to win the reference if we get through their security/procurement gate.
- SLA exception: requires approval from commercial ops to accept 99.5% for a short pilot (and to be explicit in SOW about remediation).

Can you advise if we can approve Option B? If so, please confirm any guardrails you want (e.g., max pilot discount budget, sign-off needed from finance). Also flag if we need any specific legal language for the SLA variance.

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-v1.pdf; SOW-pilot-draft.docx; Carepath-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Carepath pilot — ask for pricing + SLA exception (quick)

Ben —

I reviewed the ask and I’m ok to approve Option B (30% pilot discount for 6 weeks) under the following guardrails:
- Pilot must be signed within 14 days of SOW send OR the discount expires.
- Discount capped to the pilot scope only (no carry-forward).
- Escrow/termination: include a clause that allows us to close the pilot early if configured usage or QA indicates abuse.

SLA variance: I can approve 99.5% for pilot provided Legal inserts a clear limitation of liability and that the 99.5% statement is explicitly timeboxed to the pilot SOW. Rishi — please add any required legal language and confirm you can sign off on that.

Rishi — also validate there are no unusual items in the security questionnaire (attached). If security flags anything material we will need to pause until remediation is documented.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T13:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Carepath pilot — ask for pricing + SLA exception (quick)

Ben / Marissa —

I reviewed the SOW draft and the proposed SLA variance language. Legal is comfortable with a timeboxed 99.5% pilot SLA provided we include:
- Explicit start/end dates for the pilot and the SLA period
- A statement that remedies for SLA misses during pilot are limited to credits and do not expand liability beyond what’s in the master services agreement
- A one-time approval clause: this SOW is not precedent-setting for other contracts (non-precedential language)

On the discount: commercial ops is fine with 30% for this pilot. Please add a clause that the discount automatically expires if the pilot scope expands beyond the defined token cap without prior written approval from Commercial Ops.

I’ll prepare a short supplemental clause for the SOW and send to Ben to include.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Alvarez <jenna@carepathhealth.com>, Laura Diaz <procurement@carepathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot exploration — SOW and approvals

Jenna / Laura —

Thanks again for the discussion. Quick update and next steps so procurement can move the SOW: 

1) Pricing & discount: Redwood will provide a 30% timeboxed pilot discount for the 6-week engagement (applies only to the pilot scope as drafted). Discount expires if SOW is not signed within 14 days of send.
2) SLA variance: For the pilot period only we will commit to a 99.5% availability target. Legal will include timeboxed language and limit remedies to credits (no change to broader liability).
3) Security: We received your security questionnaire. Our security team will send a short SOC2 evidence packet; if Trish flags any material items we’ll address those before ramp.

Attached: SOW-pilot-draft.docx (redlined with timeboxed SLA clause), Redwood-Proposal-v1.pdf.

If this aligns, I’ll send the finalized SOW and a DocuSign link for execution. Proposed signers we have on file: Jenna Alvarez (Sponsor) and Laura Diaz (Procurement). Please confirm the procurement timeline and any required PO references.

Thanks — look forward to getting you started.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: SOW-pilot-draft.docx (SLA supplemental clause), Redwood-Proposal-v1.pdf
